snippet.title: Asfalia: Panic at the Mansion on Steam - Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Asfalia: Panic at the Mansion on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436410/Asfalia_Panic_at_the_Mansion/
___________
Asfalia is a whimsical, cartoony adventure for players 7+ and adults alike. Join Charlie and Lily as they search for lost puppies in a hand-painted world where the stars have vanished and a growing darkness is causing havoc. Explore magical lands, meet quirky characters like a cheese-loving knife or a cleaning-obsessed marquis, and solve lighthearted puzzles that are fun but never too tricky. 

Humor-filled dialogues with cultural references make the story engaging for all ages. Collect hidden stickers, rebuild statues, outwit mischievous vultures, and help restore courage to frightened friends.

Inspired by Alice in Wonderland, Inside Out, and The Little Prince, Asfalia blends charm, humor, and heart. With professional English and French voice acting, intuitive controls, and Steam Deck compatibility, it’s perfect for trips or family play. 

Following Asfalia: The Cranky Volcano, this second adventure, Asfalia: Panic at the Mansion, expands the enchanting universe with more delightful mysteries. A vibrant, magical journey awaits!
